components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary action for Confirm Import and the single best next action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563EB; color: #FFFFFF; border: 1px solid #2563EB; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 16px; font: 600 15px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1D4ED8; border-color: #1D4ED8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1746A8; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #BBC2CC; border-color: #BBC2CC; color: #FFFFFF; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary action for samples, retry, exports, and pagination.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #FFFFFF; color: #171A1F; border: 1px solid #DDE2EA; border-radius: 6px; padding: 10px 14px; font: 600 15px/1.2 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #F7F8FA; border-color: #BBC2CC; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background: #EFF2F5; } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { color: #7F8794; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact field style for filters, file metadata, and future controls.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #5D6675; font: 600 12px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 160px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #171A1F; border: 1px solid #DDE2EA; border-radius: 6px; padding: 9px 10px; font: 400 14px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #BBC2CC; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22); border-color: #2563EB; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Text-first status label for warnings, confidence, and job state.
components.css: .ds-chip-warning { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(180, 83, 9, 0.34); background: #FFF4E5; color: #7D3A07; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 9px; font: 600 12px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-chip-warning::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 999px; background: #B45309; }

components.name: Functional Panel
components.description: Flat bordered container for upload, preview, progress, and result regions.
components.html:
Local preview

No backend or AI import runs before Confirm Import.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: #FFFFFF; color: #171A1F; border: 1px solid #DDE2EA; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 650 20px/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: #5D6675; font: 400 15px/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; max-width: 70ch; }

components.name: Preview Table
components.description: Dense review table with sticky headers and horizontal scroll.
components.css: .ds-table-wrap { overflow: auto; border: 1px solid #DDE2EA; border-radius: 8px; background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-table { width: 100%; min-width: 640px; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; color: #171A1F; font: 400 13px/1.45 system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; } .ds-table th { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #F7F8FA; color: #5D6675; text-align: left; font-weight: 650; border-bottom: 1px solid #DDE2EA; padding: 9px 10px; } .ds-table td { border-bottom: 1px solid #DDE2EA; padding: 9px 10px; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #F7F8FA; }

narrative.overview:
GrowEasy AI CSV Importer should feel like a precise operational workbench for reviewing messy data. The system is light, quiet, and evidence-first: upload controls, local preview, confirmation boundaries, progress, records, skipped rows, mappings, and exports are arranged so the user always knows what has happened and what is still pending.

The visual system rejects SaaS marketing, decorative analytics dashboards, generic AI wrapper theatrics, and admin-shell sprawl. The interface should never compete with the CSV data. Density is allowed when it improves review speed, but every dense region must have readable type, stable spacing, semantic headers, and clear actions.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained light UI with one primary blue action color.
Compact, readable tables with sticky headers and horizontal scrolling.
Functional panels, not decorative card sections.
Status color paired with text, icons, or shapes.
Minimal motion used only for state feedback.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color supplements status but never carries it alone. Every success, warning, error, and info state needs a text label or icon in addition to color.

rules.name: The One Action Color Rule
rules.body: Blue is for the primary path and selected state. Do not use it as decoration.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: This is a tool, not a landing page. Keep headings concise, fixed-size, and small enough to leave the workflow visible in the first viewport.

rules.name: The Flat Review Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated with borders and background, not decorative shadow stacks.

dos: Do keep the upload workflow, sample CSV actions, local preview guarantee, and row limit visible in the first viewport.
Do use thin neutral borders for panels, tables, inputs, and secondary buttons.
Do keep tables compact but readable, with sticky headers and horizontal scrolling instead of squeezed columns.
Do show no-backend and no-AI-before-confirmation copy near the preview and Confirm Import action.
Do pair status color with text, icons, or shapes.
Do respect reduced motion and keep transitions between 150ms and 250ms.
donts: Don't make a SaaS marketing page.
Don't use decorative analytics dashboards, generic AI wrapper visuals, oversized heroes, card-grid storytelling, or visual clutter.
Don't add sidebar navigation, admin views, dashboard charts unrelated to import progress, authentication, workspaces, billing, CRM write-back, or persistent import history.
Don't make dark mode part of v1.
Don't hide the local preview when backend or AI processing begins.
Don't rely on color alone for failed, skipped, warning, success, or info states.
